## Overview

Recreation of ColorLib Accordion 15 as `compress`.

- **Source**: ColorLib Accordion 15 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/accordion-15/`)
- **App Directory**: `apps/compress`

## Section Order & Structure

1. **Header / Navbar**: Brand title, navigation links, theme toggle.
2. **Hero Section**: Intro title and brief description of the profile widget accordion system.
3. **Interactive Accordions**: Multiple profile card accordions with smooth expand/collapse states.
4. **Feature Highlights**: Grid of profile attribute features and stats.
5. **Footer**: Copyright, links, and mandatory Component Dock link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).
